audit_kind: Metadata/source feasibility only; not finalized protocol, model ranking, evaluation, dataset legal opinion or final-source selection.

evidence_classes.MEASURED: Direct metadata/source inspection; statements about corpus collection, split hygiene, licenses or vendor training are publisher claims unless independently reconstructed.
evidence_classes.INFERENCE: Reasoned leakage/grouping risk; no rows compared or model contamination established.
evidence_classes.HYPOTHESIS: Proposed future source/transfer role, not achieved capability.

scope_guards.large_downloads: None; APIs, READMEs/licenses and one research paper PDF only.

license_policy.shipping-train: Primary permissive dataset grant established; attribution and modification duties apply; never extends to unknown upstream rights. No final/model artifacts have been trained or shipped by this audit.
license_policy.conditional/review: Commercial-use-compatible declared grant may exist, but provenance, upstream grants, SA obligations, or data-versus-code scope still require documented review before shipping training.
license_policy.research-eval-only: NC/research-only/missing/ambiguous sources excluded from shipping training. Missing license is not a grant of research redistribution permission either.
license_policy.weights_vs_data: A pretrained model Apache/MIT weight license never proves its training datasets permissible or establishes unknown training provenance; peer model inventory/parent must track both independently.

provenance.source_statement: 21362 prompt-response rows; mostly ShareGPT user prompts plus about 5% Scale human prompts; two responses per prompt from a mix of ten early in-house LLMs. Scale human annotators rate helpfulness/correctness/coherence/complexity/verbosity on 0–4 Likert scale; released scores are means after outlier filtering.
